grammar-lee settings

grammar-lee is on

Click into any text box and mistakes get underlined. Red is correctness, blue is clarity. Hover an underline to fix it, or click the round badge in the corner of the box to see every suggestion.

All checking happens on this computer. Turn on LanguageTool below if you want a second, deeper grammar engine.

General

grammar-lee on
English variety
Clarity suggestions
Style, readability, redundancy and Oxford comma (blue underlines)
Autocorrect as you type
Fixes a typo the moment you finish the word, only when grammar-lee is confident. A toast lets you undo; undone words are never autocorrected again.
Check delay
How long after you stop typing before checking

LanguageTool (optional, local)

Runs a LanguageTool server on your own machine for extra grammar rules on top of Harper. Install it with ./setup-languagetool.sh from the grammar-lee folder. Only localhost addresses are accepted, so your text never goes to the cloud.
Use LanguageTool
Server address
Not tested
Picky mode
Adds LanguageTool's stricter style rules

Personal dictionary

One word per line. These are never flagged as spelling mistakes. Pre-loaded with your names, projects, societies and technical terms.
Saved

Learned corrections

Fixes you accepted. These are ranked first and can be autocorrected. Click × to forget one.

Never autocorrect

Words you undid an autocorrect on. They are still underlined, just never changed automatically.

Rules turned off

Rules you switched off from a suggestion card. Click × to turn one back on.
